status: Exploratory after the registered development common-inventory coverage failed; registered BEFORE calculating all-inventory work. Primary failed. No audit, support replacement, new subgroup, model, geometry, temperature or primary claim.
data: Reuse cold development 16 disjoint blocks [4096,4608), their archived exact two-half work sums and BOTH count arrays. Do not recalculate native work. For independent one-parent frequencies and their uncertainty, pair each block k with 32 different cold FIT parents [256+32k,288+32k), outside the original frequency calibration. Keep all 16 blocks independent. No audit access. Also show the original pooled one-parent empirical weights as a sensitivity using the same cells, never pair-frequency weights.
target: Same inventory-only, optimized and affine mean W at beta=3.05, now over ALL inventories. A cell is observed when it has at least one opportunity on each of two independent halves, with no minimum count or shrinkage. Keep all such cells. For each missing (arm,inventory,label) cell (including zero in both halves), do not substitute a fitted or zero work: bound the unknown W in [-B_s,+B_s]. Use the same paired signed reductions and 5% of cold inventory-only mismatch margin. Empirical identified set addresses missing cells, not infinite-sample guarantees for estimated supported work.
bound: For interior word pair u,v the cross work is (Uu-Uv).(X2-X1). Per corner U=(o,b), b=2o(d_in-ideal). Given e in {0,1,2,3} occupied outward neighbors, h=sum of outward occupied-owner [2*(d_j excluding corner-ideal_j)+1] satisfies -9e<=h<=5e (other coordination 0..5, ideals 3,5). A possible value of that corner's contribution (Uu-Uv).X is do*(e^2+h)+db*e. Its range length is bounded by max minus min over all four e and both h endpoints. Sum the eight range lengths and maximize over every pair of the 6561 LUT words in this stratum to get B_s. This relaxes inter-corner exterior consistency, so B_s is an upper bound even with full canonical constraints; singleton words give B_s=0. Report numeric largest bound. Independent coarse cross-check: each inside A or B owner can change by at most 9 or 21 for a fixed interior, up to 3 changed neighbors; each of 24 exterior owners can change by at most 9; two boxes give global 768. Check every theoretical bound <=768.
aggregation: Block center c_a=sum_s p_s * supported_cell_work_s; block radius r_a=sum_{s missing} p_s B_s. For contrast with coefficients v, endpoints are v.c +/- sum_a |v_a| r_a; for margin-centered contrast subtract .05 from the inventory-only coefficient, accounting for the uncertainty of the margin too. This does not require the unknown works in different cells to be independent. Report per-arm one-parent weight of unsupported cells, theoretical missing-cell count, radius, and surviving pair counts.
uncertainty: Give empirical identified-set endpoints and separately simultaneous one-sided Student-t bounds on its lower and upper endpoints across 16 independent dev+mass blocks (alpha=.05/6 each for three paired contrasts, separately for sign and material margin families). Paired mass-bank uncertainty is included; this is approximate parent-cluster inference. Also give a deliberately conservative missing-mass sensitivity bound: conditional on dev supports, 512 independent fit parents each contribute normalized missing radius in [0,1] (divide by largest B over missing cells in this arm). Invert n*KL(Bern(observed mean)||Bern(upper))=log(3/.05) per arm; Chernoff-Hoeffding applies to independent bounded, even non-identical, variables. Use resulting simultaneous upper bounds for the three missing radii instead of estimated radii; state whether unknown work could then reverse a sign or margin, treating supported centers as estimates, not exact. Small means do not establish zero population missing mass. No audit or population confirmation from this supplement.
diagnostic: Explain primary failure by inventory frequency and subcell calibration support counts only; do not select or report an effect on a newly favorable inventory subset. Report comparisons as bounded, materially excluded, or unresolved rather than silently impute missing classes.
